title: Construction of the strict tensor quotient augmentation
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and an arbitrary scheme T in the same universe. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaf R_T of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the ordinary signed direct-sum total tensor of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and the actual finite tensor tower and its Roos complex of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. The quotient completion unit is natural. Whiskering it by ordinary total tensor and composing with the normalized tensor tower isomorphism gives a natural transformation from ordinary total tensor to the completed strict tensor complex. Its component at each pair of complexes is exactly IntegralAmbient.tensorOperationUnit of [lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models]. The map is constructed from the natural slice completion unit and normalized tensor tower isomorphism. No flatness, completeness, constructibility or invertibility assumption on ell on T is required.

source.place: The tensor-product operation in the proof, specialized to the strict quotient completion augmentation; the representative formula of def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports.

proof.text: The quotient units form a natural transformation from the identity functor to the Roos complex of the quotient tower, by naturality of the slice product augmentation and zero shifted coordinate. Whisker this transformation by the ordinary total tensor functor. Compose it with the Roos image of the normalized whole-tower tensor isomorphism of lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models. This constructs the strict tensor augmentation functorially on every pair of complexes.

Use the recorded sheafification and locally bijective criterion at coefficient universe u+1 from lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated; this pins the universe of the ordinary total tensor and introduces no geometric hypothesis.
